title: Auto Farm bullet tp no fire rate no recoil n more
features:
FEATURES 

COMBAT TAB
Silent Aim
Enable Silent Aim - Locks your shots onto zombies automatically
Closest Zombie Mode - Ignores FOV, aims at absolute closest zombie even behind you
Wall Check - Only aims at zombies visible (not through walls)
Show FOV Circle - Displays the FOV circle on screen
FOV Radius - Adjustable FOV size (50-800)
Zombie Chams - Rainbow highlight on all zombies (see through walls)
Freeze Zombies - Expands zombie hitboxes making them stuck/frozen

Auto Farm
Auto Farm (Sky) - Teleports to sky, stays locked, auto kills all zombies with bullet TP, returns to original position when disabled
Bullet TP - Bullets teleport to zombies while you play normally (no sky teleport)

Gun Mods
No Recoil - Removes gun recoil, spread, kickback, and camera shake
No Fire Rate Limit - Removes fire rate limit for faster shooting

Melee
Melee Kill Aura - Auto attacks zombies with melee weapon (requires melee equipped)
Attack Speed - Adjustable attack speed (0.1-1.0)

Tools
Equip All Guns - Equips all guns from backpack
Equip All Melee - Equips all melee weapons from backpack
Equip All Tools - Equips everything from backpack



MISC TAB
Movement
Fly - CFrame fly with WASD + Space/Ctrl controls
Fly Speed - Adjustable fly speed (10-200)
WalkSpeed - Custom walk speed
Speed - Adjustable walk speed value (16-200)
Infinite Jump - Jump unlimited times in the air
Noclip - Walk through walls and objects

Safety
Anti Death - Teleports to sky when HP is low, returns to saved position when healed
Trigger HP - Health threshold to trigger safety teleport (10-50)
Resume HP - Health needed to return from safety (50-100)
Lava Bypass - Blocks lava damage and teleports random if touching lava, made this for a different auto farm but i removed that
